author: Tracy Schuhmacher
title: All-you-can-eat Asian restaurant opens in Henrietta | Exclusive - NewsBreak
text:
By Tracy Schuhmacher ,
14 hours ago
MOSU Asian BBQ & Hot Pot has opened in the former Red Lobster at 655 Jefferson Road in Henrietta. It is the second location for the Albany-based restaurant.
The restaurant offers two interactive all-you-care-to-eat experiences: Asian BBQ, in which diners cook their food on gas-fired ceramic charcoal grills, or hot pot, in which they cook their food in broth. Diners have two hours in which to enjoy their meals.
The Asian barbecue menu includes beef, lamb, poultry, seafood and vegetable choices. The hot pot menu is made up of broth bases, ranging from mild to spicy, to be combined with meat, seafood, vegetables, noodles and/or rice.
The menu offers vegan, vegetarian, pescatarian, halal and gluten-friendly options.
Its bar also serves craft cocktails, mocktails, wine, beer, sake, soju and an a la carte menu of shareable plates. Happy hour runs from 3 to 6 p.m. Monday through Friday, with 20% off bar fare, house wines, beer and sake.
Built in the mid-1970s, the Red Lobster building had been vacant since May 2024, when the casual-dining seafood chain shut down dozens of locations nationwide and filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy (from which it later emerged). The location at 1515 W. Ridge Road, Greece, remains open.
If you go
MOSU Asian BBQ & Hot Pot is at 655 Jefferson Road in Henrietta. It has a large free parking lot. It is open 3 to 10 p.m. Monday through Friday and noon to 10 p.m. Saturday and Sunday, with the final seating for dining at 8:30 p.m.
Find prices and make a reservation online at eatmosu.com . Call (585) 360-4420.
This story contains reporting by Marcia Greenwood.
Tracy Schuhmacher has been food and drink reporter for the past 11 years. Notice a restaurant open or close near you? Email her at tracys@gannett.com .
